NATIONAL FOREWORD 

This Indian Standard (Part 2) (Second Revision) which is identical with ISO 702/2 : 1 975 Machine 
tools—Spindlenosesandfaceplates— Sizes for interchangeability— Part 2: Camlock type, issued by 
the International Organization for Standardization (ISO), was adopted by the Bureau of Indian 
Standards on 23 November 1987 on the recommendation of the Machine Tools, Machine Tool 
Elements and Wood-Working Machines Sectional Committee (EDC 11) and approval of the 
Mechanical Engineering Division Council. 

T4its standard was first issued in 1 963. After the formulation of ISO/R 702, this standard was revised 
and split into three parts in 1 972. The ISO recommendations have since been replaced by ISO 702/1 , 
ISO 702/2 and ISO 702/3. With a view to achieving international dimensions which are basic in 
nature, this revision of IS 2582 (Part 2) and adoption of ISO 702/2:1975 has been considered. 

Thetext of thelSO standard has been approved as suitable for publication as Indian Standard without 
deviations. Certain conventions are, however, not identical to those used in Indian Standards. 
Attention is particularly drawn to the following : 

a) Wherever the words 'International Standard' appear, referring to this standard, they should 

be read as 'Indian Standard'. 

b) Comma (,) has been used as decimal marker while in IndianStandards, the current practice 
is to use a point (.) as the decimal marker. 

c) Inch dimensions^given in the ISO Standard in clauses 3.1.2, 3.2.2, 3.3.2, 3.4.2. only 
3.5.2 have been excluded as these are not prevalent in our country. 

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION 

Spindle noses of type A and of Bayonet type are covered in Parts 1 and 3 respectively of this 
standard as follows : 

IS 2582 (Part 1) : 1987/ISO 702/1 :1975 Machine tools-Spindle noses and face plates- 
Sizes for Interchangeability: Part 1 Type A 

IS 2582 (Part 3) : 1987/ISO 702/3 : 1975 Machine tools -Spindle noses and face plates - 
Sizesfor interchangeability; PartiS Boyonet type 



As in the Original Standard, this Page is Intentionally Left Blank 



IS 2582 (Part 2) : 1987 
ISO 702/2 : 1975 



1 SCOPE AND FIELD OF APPLICATION 

This International Standard specifies the sizes for interchangeability of Camlock-type lathe spindle noses and corresponding 
face plates. 

NOTE - The types "A" and "bayonet" are dealt with In parts i and (It respectively. 

2 INTERCHANGEABILITY 

Although internal mounting coniponents and assembW screws are not respectively interchangeable as they may conform with 
either metric or inch series, there is complete interchangjeabiltty between metric spindle noses and face plates in inches and 
vice versa.

ISO 702/2 : 1975
